description: seethrough-wifi-train-v1. access_points is the row list in the order access points were discovered. samples[n].vector[i] is the signal strength of access_points[i]. Every vector is the same length as access_points. 0 means that access point was not observed for that sample and was padded on upload. A measured strength is an integer from 1 to 1000. room is an integer from 1 to 5. captured_at is an ISO-8601 timestamp. Array order is the contract; do not reorder access_points without reordering every vector.
reader:
import json
doc = json.load(open("seethrough-wifi-train.json", encoding="utf-8"))
rooms = [sample["room"] for sample in doc["samples"]]
vectors = [sample["vector"] for sample in doc["samples"]]
names = [ap["bssid"] for ap in doc["access_points"]]

signal.rssi_dbm: Approximately -100 + (value - 1) / 999 * 70 dBm for values from 1 to 1000. 0 is padding, not a measurement.
